description:
Find moments across all the user's media from what you describe in plain words: media.seek across every file instead of one. looks criteria are judged on pictures: each keyframe of every video (a new keyframe wherever the picture changes, at least every 10 s, picked when the media was indexed) and each image. says criteria are judged on ~30 s passages of transcripts the media already has. You get matches per criterion across files (media, start, end, best moment and its picture), most probable first.
COST. Each keyframe or passage judged is one judgment, however many criteria (up to 32) it carries; 200 judgments are a credit. Images cost 1 each; a 10-minute video about 50 to 260 by how much its picture changes. Every file the search keeps adds to the cost, so narrow first: kind, media_ids, from, name_contains, duration and from/until_seconds are free and cut what is judged before anything is. candidates is free too: it keeps the N media whose pictures look most like looks by local similarity, far cheaper, though it can drop media where the thing is small or brief. Ask everything you are looking for in one call.
A search estimated over 1 credit is not run: the result has searched false, the estimate (judgments, credits, by kind, the largest media) and what the free filters could cut, and nothing is charged. Tell the user the cost and run it again with cost_override once they agree.
HOW TO WRITE CRITERIA. As for media.seek: say what a matching picture shows or what the speech says, one judgment each, with {instructions, criteria: {true, false}} examples for accuracy. Pictures are judged at about 512 px, so small detail (a logo in a corner, fine print) can be missed.
skipped lists media the filters kept that were not judged, and why (still indexing after import, no transcript, outside candidates): not found there is not the same as not there. Long-running: returns a task, or a job_id for job.get.

candidates.description: Judge only the media whose pictures look most like the looks criteria, by local similarity (free, no judgments): far cheaper, and can drop media where the thing is small or brief

cost_override.description: Run a search estimated over 1 credit: user_confirmed (the user saw this estimate and agreed) or user_preapproved (the user said to search whatever it costs)

from.description: Only media that came this way (media.list's from). Free

from_seconds.description: Judge each media from this second on. Free

looks.description: Name (yours) to what a matching picture shows, judged on every keyframe of each video and on each image: a statement about the picture, or {instructions, criteria: {true, false}} with a case of each

max_duration_seconds.description: Only media at most this long. Free

items.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

min_duration_seconds.description: Only media at least this long. Free

min_probability.description: A keyframe or passage matches a criterion when its probability is at least this

name_contains.description: Only media whose name contains this, ignoring case. Free

says.description: Name to what matching speech says, judged on ~30 s passages of each media's existing transcript; media without one are listed as skipped

until_seconds.description: Judge each media up to this second. Free

name: media.search

job_id.description: Job handle; the same value is the MCP task id

media_id.description: The media it is making: an import is usable in edits once its status is processing, a created media once this job completes

result.description: The result, when status is completed; otherwise job.get gives it once completed

asked.description: Per criterion: the noul question the judgment model is asked, as sent

candidates.description: With candidates: each media by its best keyframe similarity, highest first

media_id.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

credits.description: judgments at 200 a credit, plus a few seconds of running time

judgments.description: Keyframes and passages judged: one judgment each

largest.description: The media taking the most judgments, most first (up to 10)

media_id.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

items.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

end.description: Seconds where it ends: the next keyframe or the passage end

media_id.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

uri.description: looks: MCP resource, the picture at peak_seconds

matches.description: Per criterion: every match across the media, most probable first; empty when none

searched.description: false: over 1 credit without cost_override; nothing was judged or charged

skipped.description: Media the filters kept but nothing judged, and why: not found there is not the same as not there

media_id.description: Media handle from media.import or a create.* tool

warning.description: When not searched: the cost, what makes it up, and what the free filters would cut

title: Search media by natural language
